verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents scheduled flag changes, which apply targeting changes at future points in time. That is a one-off scheduled action, not a recurring job or workflow schedule. Nothing in the evidence shows repeating, cron-style or recurring workflow automation, so the scheduling feature is adjacent and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Scheduling flag changes lets you define and schedule changes to your flag's targeting rules for future points in time.
